verdict.rationale: Snyk offers some built-in automation triggered by events (auto-generated fix PRs, CI/CD pipeline scanning, Jira ticket export, and 'Policy management') but there is no evidence of a general-purpose rules engine where an AI-native user can define custom conditions and actions on arbitrary events—these are fixed, vendor-defined automations rather than user-authored rule/action pairs. missing for 10: a documented rules/policy builder with custom trigger conditions and configurable actions, evidence of arbitrary event types beyond scan/PR/Jira, and confirmation these automations are user-definable rather than fixed workflows.
